name: Remembrance of a Stranger
source:
Follow Yama after he wakes from a coma with amnesia, as he struggles to recover memories of his past, his relationships, and… that stranger. Discover a fantasy world filled with unique characters – one that may be more tied to Yama’s past than he realizes.

[From [url=https://frannq.itch.io/remembrance-of-a-stranger-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随Yama从失忆的昏迷中醒来，他努力恢复关于他的过去、他的人际关系以及……那个陌生人的记忆。探索一个充满独特角色的奇幻世界——这个世界与亚玛的过去的联系可能比他意识到的更为紧密。

[来自[url=https://frannq.itch.io/remembrance-of-a-stranger-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
